feature: Old GNU sparse byte-granular extents and complete content
rootCause: TarIn requires512-byte alignment for old GNU extent offsets/lengths even though these fields represent byte ranges. Native archive rescanning then silently skips the sparse member and displays later ordinary members. Packed data totals were not checked.
fix: Accept byte-granular extents while preserving archive512-byte blocks; validate packed byte totals, logical bounds, numeric fields, extension flags and65536map records; retain the native hole reader; hard-fail invalid sparse maps to prevent skip-and-rescan.
